title: Super TNT Mod
description: This mod add super TNT and dynamite and will soon have more TNT then you can imagine! This mod is made for neoforge.
body:
### Super TNT Mod
Turn Minecraft’s explosions up to eleven with powerful new TNT variants:

- Super TNT — an enormously powerful explosive for massive destruction.
  
- Dynamite — throwable TNT that explodes on impact.
  
- Creeper TNT — detonates normally, then spawns ten creepers around the blast.
  
- And soon there will be much more TNT in this mod!
  
Perfect for large-scale excavation, chaotic experiments, or players who believe ordinary TNT simply isn’t enough.
Requires NeoForge.
